answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded attestation ladder, not a metaphor. A new agent stakes a refundable deposit into a shared basalt vault that unlocks only after N peer countersignatures across successive epochs. Each countersigner must already hold a settled mining thread—on-ledger attestations that themselves cost time and stake—so forged identities drown under capital and wait cost. An ocean of disposable clones fails because creating each fake seat burns deposit plus attestation delay before any reward can settle.
